headline: 布克獎公布六強名單
context: 2026 年布克獎（Booker Prize）公布六強決選名單，曾獲獎的瑪龍詹姆斯（Marlon James）與道格拉斯史都華（Douglas Stuart）再度入圍，普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）也在名單內。獎金 5 萬英鎊，得主將於 11 月 9 日揭曉。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The two authors are in the running for the £50,000 award alongside a Pulitzer winner, a science fiction legend, a comic writer and a debut novelist • Booker judge Mary Beard on this year’s shortlist This year’s Booker prize shortlist features some very familiar names – previous winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are in the running once more, along with Pulitzer winner Elizabeth Strout and prominent British speculative fiction writer M John Harrison. Novelist and poet Luke Kennard and debut novelist Rebecca Perry are also in contention for the £50,000 prize, the winner of which will be announced on Monday 9 November. James, the Jamaican writer who took home the prize in 2015 for A Brief History of Seven Killings, was shortlisted this time for The Disappearers . Set in Aids-era Jamaica, the novel centres around an attack on a group of queer men rehearsing John Herbert’s prison-set play Fortune and Men’s Eyes. Coming in at 640 pages, it’s the longest on the list. Continue reading...
sources.title: Previous winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart shortlisted for Booker prize

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: If James wins for “The Disappearers” or Stuart for “John of John,” it would be a rare second win for an author in the history of the prestigious literary award.

thread_text:
2026 年布克獎（Booker Prize）公布六強決選名單，兩位前獲獎者瑪龍詹姆斯（Marlon James，代表作《The Disappearers》）與道格拉斯史都華（Douglas Stuart，代表作《John of John》）雙雙再度入圍；名單中還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）、科幻文壇老將 M·約翰·哈里森（M John Harrison），以及兩位新面孔盧克肯納德（Luke Kennard）與麗貝卡佩里（Rebecca Perry）。獎金 5 萬英鎊，得主將於 11 月 9 日揭曉——如果詹姆斯或史都華再度奪冠，會是布克獎史上罕見的二度得獎紀錄。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times，2026 年 9 月 23 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
2026 年布克獎（Booker Prize）公布六強決選名單，兩位前獲獎者瑪龍詹姆斯（Marlon James，代表作《The Disappearers》）與道格拉斯史都華（Douglas Stuart，代表作《John of John》）雙雙再度入圍；名單中還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）、科幻文壇老將 M·約翰·哈里森（M John Harrison），以及兩位新面孔盧克肯納德（Luke Kennard）與麗貝卡佩里（Rebecca Perry）。獎金 5 萬英鎊，得主將於 11 月 9 日揭曉——如果詹姆斯或史都華再度奪冠，會是布克獎史上罕見的二度得獎紀錄。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 23 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 布克獎公布今年的六強名單，兩位前得主再度入圍。瑪龍詹姆斯跟道格拉斯史都華，都曾經拿過布克獎，這次雙雙再度入圍。名單裡還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特，跟科幻文壇的老將 M·約翰·哈里森。得獎名單將在 11 月 9 日揭曉，獎金是 5 萬英鎊。如果詹姆斯或史都華這次再拿一次，會是布克獎歷史上很少見的二度得獎紀錄。
